svg.title: Find Pull Push and Fetch in VS Code after integrating remote work
svg.desc: 1: Pull fetches and integrates remote work; this capture is after the pull and merge. 2: Push publishes local commits; the visible post-pull state is zero incoming and two outgoing. 3: Fetch updates knowledge of the remote without integrating its commits.

g.aria-label: Pull fetches and integrates remote work; this capture is after the pull and merge
Push publishes local commits; the visible post-pull state is zero incoming and two outgoing
Fetch updates knowledge of the remote without integrating its commits
